title: terrain
summary: Benilla's terrain.rs is Bevy material/pipeline plumbing (splat ExtendedMaterial, WGSL bindings, per-flag blend/depth specialization for M2/WMO/liquid/WDL). MSUI achieves the observable scene through its own OpenGL pipeline: per-tile ADT splat terrain with height queries, MCLQ liquid with depth fade and submerged tint, foliage, WMO/doodad renderers and WoW-style lighting.
